runtime: aem-boilerplate (vendored scripts/aem.js, stock scripts/scripts.js with loadEager/loadLazy/loadDelayed; consent-check.js in loadDelayed)

blockDecoration.wrapTextNodes:
bare text/inline cells inside block rows are wrapped in

; cells whose first child is P/PRE/UL/OL/PICTURE/TABLE/BLOCKQUOTE/H1-H6 are left alone (PICTURE + siblings/text gets wrapped)

sectionWrapper.defaultContent: consecutive non-div children are grouped into div.default-content-wrapper
sectionWrapper.blockWrapper: each block div sits in its own anonymous div, classed <name>-wrapper by decorateBlock
sectionWrapper.preLoadHiding: decorateSections sets inline style display:none on every section; loadSection clears it (display=null) when data-section-status becomes loaded
sectionWrapper.transparencyRule: styles.css: main .section, main .section > div { margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: none; } so element margins collapse between siblings exactly like the flat source body

buttonization: formatted-only: decorateButtons returns early unless the is inside or ; bare links are never buttonized (also skipped: links containing , paragraphs with extra text, URL-display links). Side effect on every `p a[href]`: a.title defaults to a.textContent.

autoBlocks.hero: never: buildAutoBlocks has no buildHeroBlock; h1 + picture is left as default content
autoBlocks.fragment: a[href*="/fragments/"] not already inside .fragment is replaced by the fragment's children

fragmentScriptPolicy: authored content never carries <script>; head.html CSP is script-src 'nonce-aem' 'strict-dynamic' + require-trusted-types-for 'script', and scripts.js installs a default trustedTypes policy that strips <script> from createContextualFragment/document.write sinks and iframe srcdoc. Inline on* handlers never fire. loadFragment(path) fetches <path>.plain.html, runs decorateMain + loadSections, returns a <main> whose children are decorated sections.
emptySectionCollapseNote: not provided by aem.js or the vendored boilerplate css; styles.css carries main .section:empty { display: none; } (the metadata block is consumed by the pipeline, which may leave an empty section)
fonts: loadFonts() loads styles/fonts.css (desktop or sessionStorage flag) — the file is comment-only; the source serves no web font, font stacks fall back to Segoe UI/system-ui and Georgia

chrome.header: loadHeader appends div.header.block into body > header in loadLazy; header.js builds nav.site-header and MOVES the authored <a> elements from /nav (getMetadata('nav') override)
chrome.footer:
loadFooter appends div.footer.block into body > footer; footer.js builds div.site-footer and MOVES the authored

from /footer (getMetadata('footer') override)
chrome.visibility: header .header / footer .footer are visibility:hidden until data-block-status=loaded; header is in normal flow (no --nav-height reservation, no fixed/sticky)
